name: local-web-qa-studio
description: Self-hosted local Android QA & Developer Studio — Kiri-first lightweight alternative to Android Studio AVD and BrowserStack

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n ORCHESTRATOR,WEB-UI -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace=@qa-studio/orchestrator" "npm run dev --workspace=@qa-studio/web-ui"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k -n ORCHESTRATOR,WEB-UI,TAURI -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=@qa-studio/orchestrator" "npm run dev --workspace=@qa-studio/web-ui" "npm run dev --workspace=@qa-studio/desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@qa-studio/orchestrator && npm run build --workspace=@qa-studio/web-ui
scripts.build:desktop: node scripts/fetch-platform-tools.js && npm run build --workspace=@qa-studio/web-ui && node scripts/build-sidecars.js && npm run build --workspace=@qa-studio/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@qa-studio/orchestrator && npm run typecheck --workspace=@qa-studio/web-ui && npm run typecheck --workspace=@qa-studio/landing
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n ORCHESTRATOR,WEB-UI -c cyan,green "npm run start --workspace=@qa-studio/orchestrator" "npm run preview --workspace=@qa-studio/web-ui"
